title: Cubic Class Number P Lines
objective: Implement a bounded generic cubic class-number-only producer using exact Minkowski relations and replayable modular norm-form injectivity certificates, with honest public fallback and caching

oracles: Exact relation, factor-base, presentation, and modular norm-form replay

handoff.summary: Added a strict ordinary cubic_class_number module that constructs a complete unconditional Minkowski factor base, collects rank-only exact relations, and proves the resulting finite presentation injects into the class group by exhaustive modular norm-form obstructions on every projective p-torsion line. The authenticated certificate replays factor-base generation, every relation witness, presentation transforms, ideal reconstruction, norm-form interpolation, and residue coverage under hard tree/work caps and cancellation. NumberField.class_number uses this only for degree-three auto/no-limits calls, caches only successful exact artifacts across both proof modes, and otherwise retains the coupled class/unit fallback. The discriminant -1083 class-number-three target measures 7.45 seconds total (0.97 factor base, 4.66 relations, 0.20 obstruction, 0.07 encoding), without unit, regulator, or analytic workspace calls.
risks: The modular obstruction search is deliberately bounded and may honestly decline other cubic fields even after producing a useful exact relation seed; the current coupled fallback does not yet consume that retained seed.

The new strict module is 35342 bytes. Its pyrightconfig.json registration is intentionally left to the integration lane because that shared manifest is outside this arithmetic-algebra lane; direct Pyright reports zero errors.
Broad native/public corpus gates were deferred to central integration as requested; focused source/runtime and strict existing-module gates pass.
next_steps: Register src/lib/sagejs/number_fields/cubic_class_number.py in pyrightconfig.json and update the central number-field algorithm byte ratchet for the new 35342-byte module.
Teach the coupled class/unit engine to accept the retained authenticated factor-base/relation seed when bounded p-line obstruction search declines.
Profile the remaining approximately 1.5 seconds outside named producer phases and the 4.66-second relation phase in a later P7 pass.
